subject: Resume Westside Watch visual mainline now; do not restart visual discovery
body: MAINLINE ACCEPTANCE. Do not restart visual exploration and do not redesign from zero. Preserve the accumulated Westside visual language: Editorial Gravity; information-as-brick, weight-as-battlement, time-as-flow; 5:8 highest editorial weight; Light + Line/Engraving + Architecture; Cormorant Garamond/Noto Serif TC intent; First Light Gold/Watch Night/Living Paper; quiet architectural Christian editorial dawn character. Reuse existing Framesmith artifact EcpxRgfb5L when supported. First unblock real rendering, then produce screenshot 1, make one meaningful same-artifact visual refinement based on existing evaluation and visual evidence, produce screenshot 2, evaluate, and persist concrete render evidence. The goal remains active until actual visible/editable Westside output passes. A child failure must not terminate the parent goal. Do not divert to memory sweep or unrelated work while this goal is active.
